label: CINERA Neutral Rendering v1 (scene AP1 -> Rec.709 / BT.1886)
notes: Tone scale form after the open-source ACES 2.0 tonescale (Siragusano); grey_out, contrast, toe and white_stops are CINERA design parameters, not standard constants. Scene gamut compression (ACES 1.3 RGC) is applied in the camera input stage, not here.

display_gamut_compression_rec709_source.method: same algorithm, gentle pair for Rec.709 sources (exact inverse used by the Rec.709 profile)
